crossRefs.note: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.
That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of…
That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat…

translations.web: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.
translations.bsb: You shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons’ share of the food offerings to the LORD; for this is what I have been commanded.
translations.kjv: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
translations.asv: and ye shall eat it in a holy place, because it is thy portion, and thy sons' portion, of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: for so I am commanded.
